view.name: Task with Task Assignees
view.query: SELECT task_assignees.id, tasklists.prefix, tasks.task_id, tasks.task_name, users.user_name FROM task_assignees INNER JOIN tasklists ON task_assignees.task_list_id = tasklists.id INNER JOIN users ON task_assignees.user_id = users.user_id INNER JOIN tasks ON task_assignees.task_list_id = tasks.task_list_id AND task_assignees.task_id = tasks.task_id
